title: GPU-Accelerated Construction of the Gabriel Graph: Parallelization Strategies and Applications to Large-Margin Classification and Graph-Based Clustering
abstract: arXiv:2610.28759v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The Gabriel graph is a proximity graph widely used in computational geometry and geometric machine learning, underlying large-margin classifiers and, as we show in this work, density-aware clustering methods. Its construction, however, has cubic time complexity $O(N^3)$ in the naive formulation, which severely limits its use on datasets beyond a few thousand samples. This paper presents a set of GPU parallelization strategies, implemented in CUDA, that make Gabriel graph construction practical at scale. translated_title: GPU加速的Gabriel图构建：并行化策略及其在大间隔分类与基于图的聚类中的应用
translated_abstract: Gabriel图是一种在计算几何和几何机器学习中被广泛使用的邻近图，它是大间隔分类器的基础，并且正如本工作所展示的，也是密度感知聚类方法的基础。然而，其朴素构建方法具有三次方时间复杂度O(N³)，这严重限制了它在超过数千个样本的数据集上的应用。本文提出了一组基于CUDA实现的GPU并行化策略，使Gabriel图的大规模构建切实可行。我们引入了：(i) 一种从线性线程索引到对应顶点对(i,j)的隐式闭式映射，无需显式的O(N²)邻接结构，并使每个线程能够在常数时间和常数内存内定位其顶点对；(ii) 一种基于位掩码、两遍扫描、原子压缩的边列表构建方法，生成仅与实际找到的边数成比例的稠密边数组；以及(iii) 一……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出一组基于CUDA的GPU并行化策略（包括从线程索引到顶点对的隐式闭式映射以及基于位掩码的原子压缩边列表构建），突破了Gabriel图朴素构建O(N³)的复杂度瓶颈，使其能够扩展到大规模数据集，并应用于大间隔分类和基于图的密度感知聚类。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces CUDA-based GPU parallelization strategies—including an implicit closed-form mapping from thread index to vertex pairs and a two-pass, bitmask-based, atomically-compacted edge-list construction—that overcome the O(N³) bottleneck of naive Gabriel graph construction, making it practical at scale for large-margin classification and density-aware graph-based clustering.
